title: Stored chemical liners carried from First Step to Ramen's Rest and sold into its bid at 900 cr or more
note: 2026-11-22 03:45 UTC (Mercury, orders.log ENT-061 block MERCURY: carry to far buyers). The liner test's load sold 26 of 32 into First Step's bid of 759 (route trade-chemical-liner-beta-to-first-step, runs of 2026-11-22 00:30 UTC); the rest lies in storage there. Ramen's Rest at Last Light, 3 jumps from First Step, all of them Outer Rim and none with a pirate on our record in 24 hours (data/intel/sightings.jsonl), bids 1,010 x 10 (table books, read 02:43 UTC). requires.stored opens it only to the pilot whose storage holds the load. One ship, one run (rule F37: the same buyer, so one ship three times).
